generationInputs.prompt: A vintage snark poster, in the style of 1950s beauty ads with a red-toned palette on a cream background, features a luminous pink donut, an eggplant, a banana, and glowing white viscous liquid. The central element is a stylized, engraved illustration of a luminous pink donut with dripping pink liquid and white spilled milk from its base, adorned with numerous diamonds and pink sprinkles. Emerging from the donut's center are two female legs in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes, and two hands, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other a glass pipe. To the side, an eggplant and a banana, each holding a glowing syringe, are depicted. Glowing white viscous liquid is scattered throughout. A large, bold, arching headline in a mid-century serif font sits at the top, with a smaller tagline curving below. Mid-century sparkle or starburst icons are scattered around the headline. A funny footer line completes the poster, all adhering to a retro vintage tone.
